answer_1.quote: ...the author module built using GPT-2 language model ... produces novel HS/CN candidates while the reviewer(s) filter and eventually post-edit them...
answer_1.outputs: HS/CN pairs (hate speech and counter‑narrative texts)

answer_2.quote: To understand the 'diachronic' behavior of our HITL methodology across iterations, the following metrics have been computed at the end of each loop... Imbalance Degree, Acceptance Rate, HTER, Novelty, Repetition Rate, Vocabulary Expansion.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 3 annotators ... to filter and post-edit the generated pairs... We asked the operators: (a) to approve it without any modifications if it was a valid pair, (b) if the pair was not perfect, but easily amendable, to modify it, (c) if the CN is completely irrelevant ... to discard the pair, (d) whenever there are facts or statistics in the CN, check veracity of the information.
answer_4.guideline: (a) approve valid pairs, (b) modify easily amendable pairs, (c) discard irrelevant or non‑guideline‑compliant pairs, (d) verify factual statements.
